logic_errors.issue: Closing the dialog aborts an in-flight POST and resets busy, although aborting fetch does not roll back a server mutation.
logic_errors.impact: A ticket or reply can commit without its success redirect being shown. Reopening and submitting again can create duplicates: support.create and support.reply have no idempotency protection.
logic_errors.recommendation: Keep mutation state independent of dialog visibility and handle completion explicitly, or add server-side idempotency before allowing retries.

suggestions.suggestion: Distinguish failed GET requests from uncertain POST outcomes. A POST connection failure should not simply encourage retrying when the mutation may already have committed.
Announce successful content loading to assistive technology; focus currently remains on Close while the loading alert disappears.
Add coverage for closing during a delayed POST, reopening before completion, successful submissions, expired authentication, and CSRF rejection.

summary: Reviewed staged content and relevant unchanged authorization using Git index reads; ignored unstaged evidence. Role navigation, scoped detail URLs, CSRF tokens, fallback URLs, escaping, and privacy headers appear sound. Failed for the in-flight POST close/retry correctness race. No files or Git state changed; tests were not run.
